title: GALLERY
sub: visual work · not linked from the main page
lead: Things I built that are better seen than described. Each exhibit runs or plays in the browser and links to its source.

exhibits.title: AI AVATARS
exhibits.lead: A Godot 4 game where LLM agents get a body in a 2D top-down world. The tour is recorded from the game itself and walks both worlds, Magic Forest by day and Darkwood by night; the stills come from the same recording run.

media.label: Scripted tour of both worlds, recorded from the game, 99 s, no sound.

items.alt: The title screen: a moonlit castle above a lake, the world menu on the left.
Magic Forest from above: paths, a lake and ten named zones.
Mirror Lake with its bridge in daylight.
The player talking to an agent; the reply opens in a dialogue panel.
Darkwood at night: a lantern-lit road.
Darkwood: the Blackwater pool under moonlight.

exhibits.title: AI CHARTS
exhibits.lead: The local_aicharts wizard in a Moodle site: a chart is defined step by step, its query previewed, scheduled and saved to the dashboard.

media.label: Demo of the plugin, 2 min 38 s, with narration. Starts muted.

exhibits.title: THE DARK EYE
exhibits.lead: The Dark Eye's browser page, running here on a script: the eye moves through listening, thinking and speaking while the transcript fills in. The real page talks to the assistant on my machine; this copy has no backend, no microphone and no sound.

media.alt: The Dark Eye page: a dotted eye in the centre, three agent creatures orbiting it, the transcript on the right.
media.note: Scripted, about 70 s per loop. Keys 1–3 switch channels.

exhibits.title: NAVI-AGENT
exhibits.lead: NaviAgent's fairy, running here on a script: the repository's own renderer, styles and markup, fed fake notify() calls instead of an MCP client. It changes colour by kind, shows the message in a bubble and returns to idle. No sound in this copy.

media.alt: The Navi fairy glowing green beside a speech bubble that reads Task finished.
media.note: Scripted: a new notification about every 9 s.
